Tumhari mehnat matter karti, add hoti jaati.
Apna rasta chuno aur chalte raho.
He who has overcome apne fears karega, tabhi truly free hoga.
Khamoshi sikhati hai.
Kabhi kabhi silence strongest truth hota.
Grit pain ko purpose banata.
Strength tab paida hoti jab lagta—bas nahi.
Himmat change ki backbone hai.
Jis din hum un cheezon par chup ho jaate hain jo matter karti hain, us din zindagi ka end shuru hota hai.
Bura waqt hamesha nahi rehta, par majboot log hamesha tikte hain.
Khamoshi se duniya jeeto.
Jitna hum unn cheezon ko value karte hain jo hum bol nahi sakte, utna hum zyada silent ho jaate hain.
Bahadur aadmi bardasht karta hai.
Khamoshi woh sleep hai jo thought ko nourish karti.
Grit failure ko fuel bana deta hai.
Khamosh himmat zordaar ko hara deti hai.
Jo dusron ko jeete woh balwaan hai.
